Welcome to Gooderson Leisure – Your Gateway
to Unforgettable Experiences
At Gooderson Leisure, we invite you to explore the best of South Africa with our collection of diverse and unique properties, each offering a distinct experience to suit every type of traveller.
Whether you're craving a tranquil escape into nature, a vibrant beachfront getaway, or an adventurous family holiday, Gooderson Leisure has the perfect destination for you.
With a proud heritage spanning decades, Gooderson Leisure is renowned for its warm hospitality, exceptional service, and beautiful locations across KwaZulu-Natal, Mpumalanga , and beyond.
From the lush Drakensberg mountains to the unspoiled beaches of Durban’s Golden Mile, our portfolio of resorts, hotels, and lodges offer something special for everyone.
Discover family-friendly resorts , serene bush retreats, cosy self-catering chalets, and charming coastal hotels – all designed to showcase the natural beauty and rich culture of South Africa. Whether you're planning a romantic getaway, a corporate retreat, or a fun-filled family adventure, our properties cater to your every need.
Our properties
This year Gooderson Leisure celebrates 69 Years of Good Value, Good Fun. These remarkable years of hospitality excellence, dedicated service, comfort and unforgettable guests, is a testament to our passion that we continue to have every year to create that "Home away from Home" for our beloved guests.
We offer exclusive hotels and resorts across South Africa’s top holiday locations, from coast to mountains, ensuring unforgettable and great-value getaways.
